# Civo — Civo Startup Program

Three-stage cloud credit program offering up to $1,000 (Launchpad), up to $10,000 (Propel) or up to $50,000 (Elevate) in Civo credits, with technical support and community access; the program runs 6-12 months depending on stage.

| **Category** | [☁️ Cloud](../categories/cloud.md) |

| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $50,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Expiry** | The program lasts for 6-12 months, depending on the stage you're accepted into. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Launchpad | $1,000 | For early-stage startups, Launchpad provides up to $1,000 in cloud credits, technical support, and community access to help you get off the ground. | _Not stated by the vendor_ |
| Propel | $10,000 | For startups that have achieved some traction, Propel offers up to $10,000 in cloud credits, dedicated technical support, and access to Civo's network of partners and investors to help you scale. | _Not stated by the vendor_ |
| Elevate | $50,000 | For established startups looking to scale rapidly, Elevate provides up to $50,000 in cloud credits, personalized technical support, and strategic guidance from Civo's experienced team. | _Not stated by the vendor_ |

### Not covered

- GPU instances are not included in the program's credit allocation.

> **Stacking:** 'Are there any additional costs or fees associated with the program?' - 'No, there are no additional costs or fees associated with the program.'
